tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

THE BIDDER SHALL QUOTE RATES WITHOUT ADDING GST FOR EITHER MATERIALS OR WORKS CONTRACT OR SERVICE GST PAYABLE BY THE BIDDER UNDER THIS WORKS CONTRACT WILL BE PAID TO THE CONTRACTOR OVER AND ABOVE THE BIDDERS BID AMOUNT. AND THE INCREASE IN THE GST SHALL NOT BE PAID IN THE EXTENDED PERIOD OF CONTRACT FOR WHICH THE BIDDER ALONE IS RESPONSIBLE FOR DELAY AS DETERMINED BY THE AUTHORITY.
THE BIDDER SHOULD READ ALL THE GENERAL CONDITION IN INSTRUCTION TO BIDDER FILE IN THE TENDER AND OBEY ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS
THE BIDDER QUOTED RATE VALID UPTO 2500KM OR 300 WORKING HOURS AS PER GOVT ORDER.
